import pathlib,subprocess,sys,re
p=pathlib.Path.cwd()
for n in ['nesterov','craig']:
 z=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout',str(p/f'sources/{n}.pdf'),'-'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30);assert z.returncode==0
 w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),f'sources/{n}.txt'],input=z.stdout,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=10);assert w.returncode==0
 print(n,'CHARS',len(z.stdout));print(z.stdout[:19000])
